meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: Claude 会按照 HyperFrames 格式创建一个可导航的幻灯片 deck，包含离散幻灯片、片段渐显、分支导航和演讲者笔记。输出的是可运行的 deck，不是视频文件。如果用户没明确要求做幻灯片，Claude 会先确认再动手。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、演示或推销 deck 时触发。如果通过 /hyperframes 命令进来，则自动执行；如果是相关请求（如“把这篇网页转成 deck”），Claude 会先询问你是否要生成幻灯片。

say.text: 给我做一个关于我们新产品的幻灯片deck。
把这篇博客文章转成幻灯片形式。
say.note: Claude 会保留原页面设计并转换成幻灯片。

say.text: 在这个幻灯片里加一个热点，链接到详细页面。
say.note: Claude 会在指定位置添加可点击热点。

howto.what_en: Claude creates a navigable HyperFrames slideshow deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and presenter mode with speaker notes. Output is a runnable deck, not a video. Confirms if the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a slideshow, presentation, pitch deck, or similar. If via /hyperframes, it's auto-confirmed. For related requests like 'convert this page,' Claude asks if you want a slideshow first.

say_en.text: Create a slideshow deck for our new product.
say_en.note: Claude builds a HyperFrames deck with slides, branching, and hotspots.

say_en.text: Convert this blog post into a slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude preserves the original design and turns it into slides.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on this slide linking to the detail page.
say_en.note: Claude places a clickable hotspot at the specified region.
